summary: Rulings D3/D4 applied; the plan was already written to them. The pass also brought the plan in line with slice 039, closed ad hoc this morning, which stopped vendoring the library: P5, V08 and the ordering now give ChartsDeploy and RegistryDeploy the plain bump, with ChartsDeploy pushed last on its own. Close-out A1 (before /dev:run-slice) asks the operator to push 039's three unpushed commits, in Charts, ChartsDeploy and RegistryDeploy.
